title: Methodology and development of a machine learning probability calculator: Data heterogeneity limits ability to predict recurrence after arthroscopic Bankart repair.
summary: The ML probability calculator is developed from pooled Bankart-repair literature with heterogeneity constraints and internally evaluated for recurrence; interpret as retrospective risk estimation. First publication date 2024-09-26 is corroborated by the primary bibliographic entry.
